course_description: Focuses on administration of operating systems in a client-server technology (Windows and Linux on Virtual Machine), installation and maintenance. It prepares students to installation of Windows Server, NTFS file system and folder permissions, Domain Name System, Active Director, local and domain Group Policy, Windows Terminal Services, Internet Security and Acceleration Server, Internet Information Services, communications and networking.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Understand how Linux is used and the basics of the command line;
Build foundational knowledge for progressively mastering Linux Commands; and
Examine the roles and responsibilities of a System Administrator.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Perform post-installation configuration of Windows Server 2019
Explain how to install domain controller
Describe the purpose of Domain Controller
Manage user accounts with graphical Tools
Manage group and computer accounts using Windows Server tools and PowerShell

course_learning_outcomes.text: Understand how Linux is used, navigate the system, and basics of the command line and its structure.
Build foundational knowledge for progressively mastering Linux commands
Examines the roles and responsibilities of a System Administrator

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Install and configure a computer running Linux
Navigation of home and system directories and listing files in various locations TLO12. Understanding and manipulating file permissions and ownership settings
Create, move and delete files and directories under the home directory ITLO14. Understanding and manipulating file permissions and ownership settings
